rules.topic: ME Controller: each face is a dense-capacity channel source; the controller itself does not relay channels
rules.value: Per controller face: 32 x cable_factor channels routed into the attached dense-capacity segment. CANNOT_CARRY means channels originate at the face instead of passing through the controller block.
Example: a quartz fiber joins two networks for power transfer only — no channels (and therefore no devices) pass through it. Each side keeps its own channel accounting.

rules.topic: P2P tunnel cost on the backbone network
rules.value: A P2P tunnel output node requires exactly one channel on the backbone, flagged COMPRESSED_CHANNEL: that single channel carries the tunneled subnet's channels. The tunnel part itself is DENSE_CAPACITY + CANNOT_CARRY_COMPRESSED (line 73), so a P2P tunnel cannot be routed through another P2P tunnel.

The quantum bridge's grid node is DENSE_CAPACITY: each side of the bridge behaves like a dense segment (32 x cable_factor channels). Two bridges linked by an entangled singularity pair join their networks across arbitrary distance and dimensions.
